According to the American Heart Association (AHA), a normal resting heart rate for an average adult is typically less than 100 beats per minute. However, athletes and physically active individuals may have a lower resting heart rate of around 60-100 bpm without any issues.

It's important to note that a resting heart rate can vary based on individual factors such as age, gender, and physical activity level. Always consult with a healthcare professional for personalized health advice.
